summary: Nomad Foods Ltd filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on May 7, 2026, reporting its financial results for the first quarter ended March 31, 2026. The filing includes a press release and unaudited interim financial statements. Reported revenue decreased 5.9% to €715 million, adjusted EBITDA fell 22.9% to €93 million, and adjusted EPS dropped 34.3% to €0.23. Management reiterated full-year organic sales and adjusted EBITDA guidance but raised adjusted EPS outlook. The filing also notes organizational restructuring and new regional president appointments. This is a routine earnings release, not a special situation.
